## ✨ Highlights

- 🤖 **Claude Code drives your nodes with janusctl**: this repository is now a Claude Code plugin marketplace, and its `janusctl` skill teaches Claude janusctl - ask in your own words why a site answers 503 or what changed on a node this week, and Claude reads the nodes, proposes the change and makes it the way the docs do: configurations validated on the node, trials that revert by themselves, one node at a time, nothing that reboots, moves traffic or touches the nodes' trust unless you asked for exactly that. `/plugin install janusctl --marketplace swenske/Janus` ([Claude Code and janusctl](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/claude-code.md)).
- ⚖️ **A server drained, HAProxy reloaded - from janusctl**: `janusctl haproxy server-state BACKEND SERVER ready|drain|maint` and `janusctl haproxy reload`, what only `janusctl tui` and the Controller could do.

## 🤖 Claude Code

- **The `janusctl` plugin** ([#359](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/359)): `/plugin marketplace add swenske/Janus` then `/plugin install janusctl@janus` (or the one step above, Claude Code 2.1.275 or later); Claude uses the skill by itself when you speak of Janus nodes, `/janusctl:janusctl` calls it. A copy of `claude-code/janusctl/skills/janusctl/` in `~/.claude/skills/` works too.
- **What each command does to a node**: every janusctl command is marked - *reads* (Claude runs it when it helps), *changes* (only what you asked for, shown first, checked after), *critical* (reboots, power, moving traffic, wipes, trust, credentials: only when you asked for that very action, after a yes). A command added to janusctl without its mark fails the build, so the skill can't drift from the CLI.
- **The guard that holds is the role**: the page shows how to give Claude a context of its own with a lower role (an SSH key of your account as a reader, `JANUSCONFIG` in Claude Code's settings) - each node refuses what the role doesn't allow, whatever Claude tries - and the `ask` rules that make Claude Code ask before every critical command, in auto mode too.
- Sign-ins stay yours: Claude uses your contexts, never signs in, never reads keys or kits.

## ⚖️ janusctl

- **`janusctl haproxy server-state BACKEND SERVER ready|drain|maint`** ([#359](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/359)): drain sends new clients to the other servers and lets the current ones finish, maint takes the server out with its health checks, ready puts it back; janusctl prints the state HAProxy reports. It lasts until HAProxy's next reload, which takes haproxy.cfg's state again - `disabled` on the server's line keeps one out for good ([your haproxy.cfg](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/haproxy-config.md)). Completion and the pickers offer the backends, the servers with their state and address, and the states.
- **`janusctl haproxy reload`** ([#359](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/359)): a seamless reload of haproxy.cfg and its files as saved - after a `file-put` without `-reload`, say ([files, maps and certificates](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/haproxy-files.md)). A failed reload exits 1 with the node's reason; a reload reminds what it undid (`server-state`, `map-set`, `acl-add`).
- Both need an operator's certificate, like the Controller's buttons; nodes of earlier releases answer them too (the API is unchanged).

## 🧪 Tests

- `hack/haproxy-runtime-test.sh` against a real HAProxy 3.0, 3.2 and 3.4: a server drained, back to haproxy.cfg's state with ready, in maint until `haproxy reload` puts it back; a reader refused both; an unknown server or state refused.
- The skill's index of the commands is generated from janusctl's command tree; every janusctl command line the skill and its page show must exist, flags included; the page's ask rules are the critical commands.
- Proven with Claude Code against a real janusd and HAProxy: a status question ran reads only; "add a frontend on 18081" ran `get-config`, a diff, `apply-config` and a probe - the frontend answered; "reboot the node" ran no reboot and asked first; "take app2 out for a patch" drained it and warned that a reload would bring it back.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- Nodes, the Controller and Terraform are unchanged but for the version: this release is about janusctl (apt `testing` while it is a pre-release) and the Claude Code plugin.
